content.code:
# Initialize a new Git repo
git init

# Clone a remote repo locally
git clone <url>

# Set your Git username
git config --global user.name "Name"

# Set your Git email
git config --global user.email "Email"

content.text: 💡 Tip: Always configure username/email before first commit.

content.code:
# See untracked, staged, and modified files
git status

# View changes in files
git diff

# See changes staged for commit
git diff --staged

content.text: 📝 Useful before committing to make sure you’re not including unwanted files.

content.code:
# Stage a specific file
git add <file>

# Stage all changes
git add .

# Commit staged changes with a message
git commit -m "Message describing changes"

# Stage & commit tracked files in one step
git commit -am "Message"

content.text: 💡 Tip: Write meaningful commit messages like "Fix cart total calculation bug".

content.code:
# List branches
git branch

# Create a new branch
git branch <branch>

# Switch to an existing branch
git switch <branch>

# Create & switch to a new branch
git switch -c <branch>

# Delete a branch
git branch -d <branch>

content.text: 📝 Workflow tip: Use feature/<feature-name> or bugfix/<issue> naming for branches.

content.code:
# List remote repos
git remote -v

# Add a remote
git remote add origin <url>

# Pull latest changes from remote branch
git pull origin <branch>

# Push local branch to remote
git push origin <branch>

# First-time push to set upstream
git push -u origin <branch>

content.text: 🔄 Always pull first to avoid conflicts before pushing.

content.code:
# Merge a branch into current branch
git merge <branch>

# Reapply commits on top of another branch
git rebase <branch>

# Interactive rebase to edit last n commits
git rebase -i HEAD~<n>

content.text: ⚠️ Use rebase carefully on shared branches—never rebase public commits.

content.code:
# Discard changes in a file
git restore <file>

# Unstage a file
git restore --staged <file>

# Undo last commit but keep changes staged
git reset --soft HEAD~1

# Undo commit, changes unstaged
git reset --mixed HEAD~1

# Delete last commit & changes permanently
git reset --hard HEAD~1

# Safely undo a commit (creates a new commit)
git revert <commit>

content.text: 💡 Tip: Use restore and revert instead of reset --hard on shared branches.

content.code:
# Save changes you aren’t ready to commit
git stash

# See stashes
git stash list

# Apply stash & remove it
git stash pop

# Apply stash without removing
git stash apply <stash@{n}>

content.text: 📝 Useful if you need to switch branches quickly without committing unfinished work.

content.code:
# See commit history
git log

# Pretty visual commit history
git log --oneline --graph --decorate

# Show details of a commit
git show <commit>

# See who changed each line in a file
git blame <file>

# Start working
git switch -c feature/add-order-api

# Work on files, then stage & commit
git add .
git commit -m "Add order creation API"

# Pull latest changes to avoid conflicts
git pull origin develop

# Push branch to remote
git push -u origin feature/add-order-api

# Create PR, merge when approved
git switch develop
git pull
git merge feature/add-order-api
git push
